newsitem.title: INDIA: Cricket-India's Board Presidents XI win toss, bats v S. Africa.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-India's Board Presidents XI win toss, bats v S. Africa.

text.p: An Indian Board President's XI won the toss on Friday and elected to bat first on the opening day of their three-day game against South Africa.

Board President's XI - Saba Karim (captain), Vikram Rathore, Gagan Khoda, V.S.S. Lakshman, Pakaj Dharmani, Amol Muzumdar, Krishna Kumar, Nitesh Parsana, Salim Ankola, Venkatapathy Raju and Narendra Hirwani.
South Africa - Hansie Cronje (captain), Andrew Hudson, Gary Kirsten, Lance Klusener, Darryl Cullinan, Jonty Rhodes, Herschelle Gibbs, Pat Symcox, Brian McMillan, Nick Boje and Fanie De Villiers.
